Uses all-reduce on full tensors (8 dispatches) but intersperses with smaller all-reduce calls on single scalars to synchronize the mean values, potentially enabling asynchronous overlap. Total ~16 dispatches but with 8 being single-scalar, enabling better pipeline utilization.

Splits computation into a bulk phase (first all-reduce to get initial sum s) and an iterative correction phase.
